resolved: Host bind mounts become separate PostgreSQL and shared ReadWriteMany media claims. The shared media storage class must be selected explicitly.
Upstream WhiteNoise serves collected static assets from bounded temporary storage without sharing the static directory with the proxy.
Hakopod owns TLS; non-root Caddy listens on port 8080 and preserves the HTTPS scheme for production Django settings.
Stable scoped secrets replace default database credentials and generated container-local signing keys.
Startup uses upstream migrations without automatic database fallback, with one application worker and a bounded bundled PostgreSQL connection budget.
The database selector can remove the bundled PostgreSQL service and use an existing metadata database without taking ownership of its infrastructure.
